verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS financial platform with SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any opt-out control for telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking in the Airwallex platform or its SDKs. The pack covers payments, cards, spend AI, webhooks and the sandbox, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
